{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Monkeys, mossy temples, and a jungle that hums with mischief."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Bargain for batik and baskets in a maze of market stalls."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Carved doors and courtyards where Ubud's royal story lingers."}]}
